events.summary: A public municipal CAE contract strengthened the buyer and procurement path while preserving the need to verify execution evidence and economics.
A candidate was held below validation because the apparent communication gain did not yet survive displaced-compute and baseline controls.
Prior-art review removed a novelty claim; the lab retained the falsification and did not promote a replacement without an executable judge.
The municipal owner-side CAE offer gained a clearer access route and evidence checklist, but remained below graduation.
AgnosticEngine remained the leader, but a withdrawn model and chunk-load failure made production reliability the binding gate.
Additional paid public-sector comparables strengthened demand evidence for owner-side CAE assistance across more than one buyer.
The causal-novelty branch was closed after prior art and execution constraints prevented a defensible benchmarkable discovery.
A third paid comparable advanced the municipal CAE Owner Pack to N6 VALIDATING; execution proof, delivery economics, and regulated boundaries remain open.
Database index selection became the first execution prospect after earlier domains were closed, but it remains unadmitted pending a reproducible PostgreSQL/HypoPG benchmark.
Revenue N6 demand evidence and Asset A6 guided intake now form a testable CAE intake-to-owner-pack crossover; no integrated result exists yet.
